Maria CS: quick week1 sync for GreenPeak private/VPC onboarding — bringing together network, IAM, KMS, and audit logs. Noted a renewal signal if we don't clear blockers by next week. Can folks confirm current blockers?
Tessa (GreenPeak): thanks — main pain: logs not flowing to our Splunk workspace, and our infra team can't finish key rotation until KMS policy is updated. Also seeing 403s from the logging lambda.
Ryan (Network): looking at egress — need the final Splunk collector IPs. Tessa, can you drop those? current outbound is: allow 0.0.0.0/0:443 for canary but we want restrict to collectors.
Tessa (GreenPeak): collectors are collect-a.greenpeak.svc (54.82.12.34) and collect-b.greenpeak.svc (3.210.45.66).
Ryan (Network): thanks. I'll push an ACL change to restrict to those two IPs, ETA ~30m. Pasting snippet: ```aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc123 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 54.82.12.34/32``` adjust for second IP.
Sara (SolutionsEng): on KMS — current key policy blocks cross-account decrypt for our greenpeak-logging role. We need the key policy to add: "Principal": {"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::777888999000:role/greenpeak-logging"} and allow kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey. Jordan, any org constraints?
Jordan (Security): that's acceptable but must include condition limiting usage to the logging role and to specific encryption context keys. I'll provide a minimal policy stanza in a moment.
Jordan (Security): policy snippet to add: ```{"Sid":"AllowLoggingRole","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::777888999000:role/greenpeak-logging"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn":"arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:777888999000:log-group:greenpeak-*"}}}``` apply to the CMK for the private deploy.
Sara (SolutionsEng): once policy is updated, we should rotate the key in a maintenance window. Tessa, are you ok with rotation Thu 09:00 UTC?
Tessa (GreenPeak): Thu 09:00 UTC works. We will coordinate on our side.
Maria CS: capturing action items: 1) Ryan to update SG/ACL to Splunk IPs (ETA 30m). 2) Jordan to send finalized JSON for KMS policy (ETA 2h). 3) Sara to schedule key rotation (Thu 09:00 UTC). 4) Engineering to validate logs post-change and report error count. Note: renewal EBR scheduled for next Tue; QBR risk increases if logs/audit not validated by then.
Ryan (Network): updated ACLs and added rules for both IPs. Verified outbound connectivity to collectors from a test instance.
deploy-bot: deploy job #6642 finished — status: success. No related errors in app proxy.
Sara (SolutionsEng): after KMS change you'll likely see the 403s drop. Please capture a sample CloudWatch tail and send.
Tessa (GreenPeak): saw 403 -> now retried and seeing 200s for new requests. Sending one sample log snippet: "{\"timestamp\":\"...\",\"status\":200,\"message\":\"log accepted\"}"
Maria CS: great progress, marking this thread as in-flight. I'll follow up tomorrow with a short pre-EBR health snapshot. If anything slips, flag ASAP — renewal risk note stands until audit logs + KMS rotation are validated. :thumbsup:
